item.figure_description:
Four figures labeled 'Figure 1', 'Figure 2', 'Figure 3', and 'Figure 4' are displayed from left to right:
- Figure 1 consists of a single circle.
- Figure 2 consists of 3 circles forming an arch or inverted V-shape: 1 circle at the top, with 1 circle touching its lower left and 1 circle touching its lower right.
- Figure 3 consists of 5 circles forming an arch: 1 circle at the apex, with 2 circles extending down to the left and 2 circles extending down to the right.
- Figure 4 consists of 7 circles forming an arch: 1 circle at the apex, with 3 circles extending down to the left and 3 circles extending down to the right.

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it.
